title: Campus Connect
tagline: A platform to connect students, share resources and collaborate on projects.
description: Campus Connect is a centralized college networking and peer-collaboration ecosystem. Students can find study buddies, share lecture notes, discover campus clubs, and build teams for hackathons.

title: Amaal Tracker
tagline: A productive habit-tracking app for Ramadan with a clean and minimal UI.
description: A cross-platform productivity and spiritual habit-tracking companion designed with minimalist aesthetics, offline data synchronization, intuitive streak visualizations, and privacy-first local storage.

title: Neograb
tagline: A hyperlocal e-commerce platform connecting local shops and customers.
description: Neograb empowers mom-and-pop local merchants with digital inventory management, real-time localized discovery, instant order notifications, and lightning-fast checkout.

title: ACM Code Arena
tagline: Real-time algorithmic duel platform with integrated sandbox execution.
description: A lightning-fast browser-based coding battle platform allowing AMTICS students to compete head-to-head in real-time with automatic test case validation and ranking ladders.

title: DocuAI Research Assistant
tagline: Intelligent question answering and semantic search for academic research papers.
description: A multi-modal document research agent powered by Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) that allows undergraduate researchers to summarize academic PDFs, extract citations, and query formulas.

title: Campus Events & Certificate Portal
tagline: Automated ticketing, QR check-ins, and cryptographic certificate issuance.
description: Streamlining university symposiums and college club events with one-click RSVP, instant QR verification at hall entrances, and automated verifiable participation certificates.
